title: Project P.I.T.T. Trade Terminal — clear items & cleanup
description: Updated for 1.0.5: Use the Trade Terminal to clear products; player-tested right-side switch vacuums items. If blocked, use Pause Menu → Clear Items (no refund).
h1: Project P.I.T.T. Trade Terminal — clear items & cleanup
quickAnswer: Trade Terminal clears/vacuums products; player-tested right-side switch can vacuum items; if piles cause stutter/crashes or block access use Pause Menu → Clear Items in 1.0.5 — it removes items but gives no refund.

facts.label: Function
facts.value: Clears/removes or vacuums products from the scene.

facts.label: Right-side switch
facts.value: Player-tested report: the switch on the terminal's right can vacuum products (Steam discussion).

facts.label: Pause Menu Clear Items
facts.value: Official 1.0.5 patch adds a 'Clear Items' button to remove items that may cause crashes or unplayable scenes.

facts.label: No refund
facts.value: Official 1.0.5 note: 'Clear Items' will not give back any money.
